questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde besøgt Skotland for 3 år siden, hvor jeg blev fuldstændig fascineret af kulturen og landskabet.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
Det eneste som gør at min oplevelse ikke er 10/10 er administration. Det administrative på Københavns Universitet og Glasgow University. Der var flere fejl i det dokument KU havde lavet om universitet og meget få informationer om sprogtest med videre. Derudover har den gennemsnitlige ventetid på en mail været 20 dage for KU, hvilket ikke er særlig rart, når man står I en helt uvant situation.

MED det til side har det været en HELT fantastisk oplevelse.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var okay. Glasgow University kom med information via mail.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Det var kaos med kursus tilmelding, men ellers var det fint.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
Det var en enorm stor udfordring. KU havde givet information om at Glasgow Universitet ville hjælpe med at finde bolig. Der var dog ingen hjælp at hente.

Der var ingen mulighed for at leje et værelse i fire måneder, hvorfor jeg måtte leje et værelse i 9 måneder. Resten kunne jeg så derefter udleje til en anden.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det var helt okay at bo udenfor campus. Glasgow universitet ligger i West end og jeg boede i East end, hvor bymidten er. Virkelig dejlig by.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: De fleste lejede igennem AirBnB.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var lidt et kaos. Jeg søgte fire fag, men fik ingen af de fag tildelt.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man søgte online. Jeg fik dog ikke nogen af de fag, hvorfor jeg skulle skrive til den kursusansvarlige.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: GU hjalp ved at man kunne skrive over mail eller møde personligt op.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg endte med at få de fag som jeg gerne ville trods kaos.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hav lidt tålmodighed. De første to uger er en drop off drop on periode, så det løser sig ofte der.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det er meget tydligt at underviserne var meget kompetente. Jeg var lidt i tvivl om hvor formelt undervisningen ville være, men jeg blev positivt overrasket.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg tog et 1. års fag og to 3. års fag.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde kun 6 timers undervisning om ugen. Det bestod af seminarer.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
The principles of health law
Criminal law and evidence
Criminal justice

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:

questions.answer: Det var nemt. De minder om os, bare mere indkluderende.

questions.answer: Deres måde ikke at dømme andre på.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Deltag i en klub.
Husk varmt tøj.
Hav tålmodighed med administrationen.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Glem alt om en paraply. Det er kun for turisterne. :-) (Vinden er for stærk til paraplyer)

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Alle de dejlige mennesker som jeg nu kender.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At tilpasse sig deres retssystem. (Common law)
